black_swans.name: 1973–1982 Stagflation Surge After Inheritance
black_swans.historical_basis: BLS CPI-U (11.0%–13.5% peaks), NBER 1973–75 & 1980–82 recessions, FHFA Bay Area HPI
black_swans.mechanism: Double-digit inflation erodes bonds/cash while Prop 13 caps assessed-value growth at 2%/yr; initial -15%/-26% equity bear market compresses S3 early before post-1982 recovery.
black_swans.winner_2076: Sell & Reinvest (Equities) — Rent wins at Year 5 during initial stagflation shock

black_swans.name: 2007–2012 GFC Housing & Stock Crash at Inheritance
black_swans.historical_basis: FHFA San Jose HPI (-26% cumulative 2007–11), S&P 500 (-37% in 2008), CA R&TC §51(a)(2) Prop 8
black_swans.mechanism: Selling in 2045 and investing lump-sum right before a 2008-style -37% crash hits equities hard in Year 2, while Prop 8 temporarily cuts rental property tax in S2; equities recover by Year 10.
black_swans.winner_2076: Sell & Reinvest (Equities) — staged 24–36 mo T-bill glidepath mitigates Year 2 drawdown

black_swans.name: 2000–2011 Dot-Com + GFC 'Lost Equity Decade'
black_swans.historical_basis: Actual 2000–2011 U.S. & Bay Area sequence (-9.1%, -11.9%, -22.1% S&P followed by 2008 -37.0%)
black_swans.mechanism: Worst modern 10-year sequence for lump-sum stock investing: Rent (S2) leads Sell-into-Stocks (S3) at Year 10 by >$1.9M (real), before long-run equity compounding overtakes by Year 20.
black_swans.winner_2076: Rent wins at 10-yr mark; Sell & Reinvest (Equities) wins by 2076

black_swans.name: 1929–1938 Great Depression Deflation Shock
black_swans.historical_basis: BLS Historical CPI-U Table 24 (-6.4%, -9.3%, -10.3% deflation in 1930–32) & NBER 43-month contraction
black_swans.mechanism: Severe price/asset deflation slashes nominal equities and housing simultaneously; Treasury bills preserve nominal principal and gain ~28% real purchasing power during the first 3 years.
black_swans.winner_2076: T-Bills / Balanced 60/40 protect Years 1–5; Equities still lead by 2076 after rebound

black_swans.name: 30-Year Secular Stagnation ('Lost Decades')
black_swans.historical_basis: Post-1990 asset-bubble stagnation benchmark (0.4% CPI, 2.2% equity total return, flat housing)
black_swans.mechanism: The ONE structural regime where selling into stocks loses to keeping and renting Property A: rental yield (~2.7% net of Prop 8-reduced taxes) outpaces 2.2% stagnant equities over 31 years.
black_swans.winner_2076: Rent Property A (S2) beats Sell & Reinvest (S3) under multi-decade equity stagnation

black_swans.name: Bay Area M≥6.7 Earthquake Uninsured Structural Shock (2050)
black_swans.historical_basis: USGS Fact Sheet 2016-3020 (72% 30-yr M≥6.7 probability) + CDI Form 401 earthquake exclusion
black_swans.mechanism: Standard HO-3 / landlord policies exclude earthquake damage; an uninsured 18% structural rebuild shock on Property A widens S3's advantage because a diversified global/US equity fund has no single-parcel seismic concentration.
black_swans.winner_2076: Sell & Reinvest (Equities) — eliminates concentrated single-parcel seismic tail risk

black_swans.name: 20-Year NEM Solar Sunset + 6.5%/yr CA Insurance & Water Escalation
black_swans.historical_basis: CPUC D.14-03-041 (20-yr NEM sunset), Res. E-5354 ($24.15/mo fixed charge), SFPUC FY26-28 (+7%–10%/yr), CDI market hardening
black_swans.mechanism: Cupertino solar net credit flips to a net bill once the 20-yr NEM window closes, while insurance and water compound at 6.5%/yr — eroding Property A net operating yield and further favoring Sale & Reinvestment.
